caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object is a flask-shaped container with a teardrop body, wider at the base and tapering smoothly to a narrower neck. The body is rendered in shades of brown and appears textured, resembling leather or a similarly rugged material. The neck and cap of the container are depicted in brass or gold tones, with metallic highlights suggesting a reflective surface. The container's cap includes a small lever or knob on the left side and is topped with a short, cylindrical spout. Near the bottom right side of the flask’s body, there is a small, circular metal loop attached, possibly for hanging or attaching the object. There are no other objects, figures, or additional markings except for the artist’s signature lightly inscribed in blue near the lower edge of the image.
title: Powder Horn
